final_topology.title: High-Frequency Trading Infrastructure
final_topology.description: Supports high-frequency trading with market data ingestion, processing, and order routing to three main sites.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes a central data center for processing, connected to multiple exchange data feeds and three main sites for order execution. It emphasizes resilience and clear data flow.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n26) that manages inventory for various nodes, indicating a detailed asset inventory is maintained.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes numerous labeled data flows (e.g., nl1, nl2, etc.) and zone links (e.g., zl1, zl2, etc.), indicating documented data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for different types of data processing and storage (e.g., z1, z3, z4, z5, z7) and data flows between these zones are controlled.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: A firewall (n5) is present in the Data Center (z1) and manages traffic to other nodes (e.g., nl8, nl9).

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: A DNS server (n16) is present in the Data Center (z1) and provides DNS resolution to other nodes (e.g., nl19).

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: An MFA gateway (n19) is present and manages MFA for remote access to sites (e.g., nl22, nl23, nl24).

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: A DNS filter (n17) is present in the Data Center (z1) and provides DNS filtering to other nodes (e.g., nl20).

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: A web proxy (n18) is present in the Data Center (z1) and provides web filtering to other nodes (e.g., nl21).

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones (e.g., z1, z3, z4, z5, z6, z7, z8, z9, z10, z11) and controlled data flows between them, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes management links (e.g., nl8, nl9, nl10, nl11) and management zones (e.g., z6, z9, z10, z11) for securely managing network infrastructure.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: An AAA server (n20) is present in the Management zone (z6) and integrates with other management nodes (e.g., nl25).

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: A VPN gateway (n27) is present in the Remote Access zone (z10) and manages remote access to the network (e.g., nl54, nl55).

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: An IDS/IPS (n14) is present in the Data Center (z1) and monitors traffic to other nodes (e.g., nl11, nl12, nl13, nl14).

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes a firewall (n5) and IDS/IPS (n14) that perform traffic filtering between network segments (e.g., nl8, nl9, nl11, nl12, nl13, nl14).

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an NAC server (n21) that manages access control for remote assets (e.g., nl26, nl27, nl28).

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: A traffic flow log collector (n28) is present in the Network Monitoring zone (z11) and collects traffic flow logs from various nodes (e.g., nl56, nl57, nl58).

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a Non-Production zone (z7) that is separate from the Data Center (z1) and other production zones (e.g., z3, z4, z5).

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: A pen test workstation (n25) and pen test process (n29) are present in the External Testing zone (z8) and are integrated with the Data Center (z1) and other zones (e.g., nl59, nl60).

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset inventory system and links to all other nodes to indicate inventory management.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an MFA gateway (n19) and AAA server (n20), but there is no explicit evidence of a VPN.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit VPN node or links are shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a VPN and links to the MFA gateway and AAA server to indicate remote device management.

findings_before.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an SIEM (n15) node with monitoring links to the Data Center nodes, but there is no explicit evidence of traffic flow log collection.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit traffic flow log collection is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a traffic flow log collector and links to the SIEM and other relevant nodes.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a pen test workstation (n25) in the External Testing zone, but there is no explicit evidence of periodic penetration testing.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit process or schedule for periodic penetration testing is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing process and links to the pen test workstation and other relevant nodes.
